title: Favorite trumpet players growing up
summary: He names Pete Lacarre, Kid Punch and Kid Rainey as trumpeters he admired.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I keep interrupting you, but I forgot to ask you something more. When you were growing up, who were some of your favorite trumpet players?

Well my favorite trumpet players was one, I'll tell you, one fella I admired for the style of playing. Pete Lacarre was one, see. I also admired Kid Punch. That's another one. Kid Punch and Pete Lacarre. I'll tell you another fella too, I admired playing too, was Kid Rainey. Kid Rainey I admired his playing too.
